How to Play
BalloonX is a high-stakes multiplayer game where the goal is to cash out before the balloon pops.

Place Your Bets: Select your stake during the "Receiving Bets" phase. To increase the action, you can place up to 4 separate bets on the same round.

The Rise: As the round begins, the balloon inflates and the multiplier rises. The higher the multiplier rises, the more you stand to win.

The Collect: Click or tap the "Collect" button for each active bet to secure your winnings. Your payout is determined by: Stake X Current Multiplier.

The Pop: If the balloon pops before you collect, your stake is lost.

Multiplayer Interaction
Live Action: Watch other players’ bets and see in real-time when they decide to cash out or when they lose their stake to a pop.

Bet History: Review the results of previous rounds to track the balloon's recent coefficients.
Fairness & Disconnection
A disconnection is defined as a loss of connection to the game system for more than 6 seconds.

During Bet Receiving: If you place a bet and then disconnect before the round starts, your bet remains valid. If you reconnect before the round ends, you can continue playing. If you fail to return, the bet will only "Collect" if it reaches the Maximum Win Cap; otherwise, it is lost if the balloon pops.

During an Active Round: If you disconnect while the balloon is already inflating, the system will automatically Collect for you at the multiplier value recorded the moment the disconnection was detected.

Before the Next Phase: If a disconnection occurs before a new betting phase begins, any pre-placed bets for the upcoming round will be voided and refunded to your balance.

Fairness: The moment the balloon pops is determined by a Random Number Generator (RNG). The outcome of each round is independent and cannot be influenced by player skill or inflation speed.

Malfunction: Any system malfunction voids all plays and payouts.
Game Version v1.0.0
The maximum RTP can be achieved by the player when opting to bet on the lowest possible crash multiplier (coefficient). Also when maximum coefficient to 25000x is reached, the win amount is auto collected.
